home.services_title: Everything you need around the ticket
home.why_title: A Dakar-based agency, not a platform
home.why_body_1: Founded in Dakar in 2009, Assirik Tours started with one simple observation: organising a flight or a full trip from Senegal meant juggling five contacts, five invoices and five versions of the same information.
home.why_body_2: We work directly with the airlines (IATA), the consulates for visa paperwork, and a hand-picked selection of hotels and local guides — so we can step in fast when a trip goes sideways.
home.final_cta_description: Tell us your project in a few sentences — destination, approximate dates, number of travellers, indicative budget. A consultant calls you back with a first estimate within 24 business hours.
